name: Automatic GitHub Actions failure and skipped-proof routing through Founder Control Room
acceptanceCriteria: The scanner captures exact workflow-run, job, pull-request or main-branch, and head-SHA evidence without mutating source code or workflow state.
Failed jobs with no executed steps or logs are classified as runner_startup_failure or workflow_no_jobs rather than application regressions.
Skipped unit and Playwright witnesses emit non-secret exact-head fingerprints and proof cookies with authority=false, remain investigation-required, and cannot satisfy complete proof.
Completed GitHub workflows are inspected for emitted test-skip receipts and skipped jobs even when the workflow conclusion is success.
Local verification reports skipped tests as warning evidence instead of silent green, and opt-in ingestion preserves each skip under its own fingerprint.
Scan-only reporting works without Supabase credentials and all credentials remain environment-only and absent from reports.

verification.evidence: Source contracts cover exact failed-run routing plus local and GitHub skipped-proof observation. Exact-head workflow, real skipped-run rehearsal, full suite, and Playwright remain required before main may move.
